usage_notes.primary_presentation: Use original-author kitchen art, chefs, food, appliance models, materials, shaders and audio for the main game presentation.
usage_notes.allowed_procedural: Procedural Unity geometry/materials may fill missing supporting structure but must not replace supplied primary roles.

contact_sheet_provenance.purpose: isolated views of supplied FBX assets, with each thumbnail independently framed
contact_sheet_provenance.materials: Supplied imported materials; one dangling delivery-counter material remap mechanically repaired before this input was issued.

geometry_policy: Imported visual bounds, file scale, alpha crop and thumbnail size are asset facts only; actual player collision, interactions and movement are defined by delivered game behavior and public session spatial semantics.
